description: This PHP source file is a part of the vtiger CRM project and handles the presentation logic for the PriceBooks module's edit and create views. It initializes necessary objects, retrieves data, sets up template variables, and renders the appropriate Smarty templates for editing or creating price book records.

classes.name: CRMEntity

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template wrapper class used in vtiger CRM for rendering views.
